summary: Incentivi RS module tested end-to-end. Backend: 16 pytest tests (config/log, premi validation, import-foglio preview/import/dedupe, conferma, calcolo, override simulation, storno, chiusura/riapertura, export xlsx, compensazioni, mio/online with non-admin Kevin, entita by date) -> 14 passed, 2 failed (override bad type 500; compensazione on store without provvigioni in month invisible). Frontend (admin with TOTP): nav, BOZZA badge, month 2026-09 fondo 1.981,25 EUR, Kevin 1st, export 200, In pagamento, Simulazione 2 scenarios (1981,25 vs 1188,75), Estratti conto Sondrio, Regole save 200, Gara EOLO table+button, Storico 2026-09 all OK.

minor.issue: Override with non-numeric value (e.g. {"eolo_fondo_pct":"abc"}) -> 500 ValueError 'could not convert string to float'. Only JSON parse errors are caught; validate override keys/types (whitelist numeric params) and return 400.

Estratti conto are built only from stores having provvigioni in the month (esterni dict). A compensation for a store with no provvigioni that month (e.g. Sondrio in 2026-06) is saved but never shown in estratti_conto and can't be deleted from the UI (orphan). Reproduced: POST compensazione Sondrio 2026-06 srls 30 -> Sondrio missing from estratti_conto. Works in 2026-09 (Sondrio has rows): avere_srls=30, saldo_srls=-30. Fix: also iterate stores present in compensazioni.

When fewer than 3 participants have valore>0, the unawarded % stays as 'residuo' (e.g. 2026-06 test: fondo 1223.38, premi 978.70, residuo 244.67), so premi sum != fondo. Probably by design, but confirm with the business rule 'premi 50/30/20 del fondo'.

Fondo is clamped with max(0, ...) but the negative deficit is not carried into the next month (e.g. 2026-07 with only a -150 storno -> fondo 0, the -75 is lost). Confirm whether a deficit should carry forward.
Dedupe is only within the same mese (ref_id foglio:gid:row + mese). Importing the same sheet into another month duplicates all rows.
POST/DELETE compensazioni and POST estratto-conto/pagato don't check whether the month is closed (conferma, storno and delete provvigione do).
No range validation: negative premi_pct, eolo_fondo_pct > 100 or negative gettone are accepted.

issues: The notification bell with its badge (top-right) overlaps the 'Vai online' button, covering part of its label
The Gettoni KPI subtitle is hardcoded to '25 € lordi a contratto' and won't update if gettone_lordo changes
Deborah's negozio shows '—' because she has no store_ids; entita falls back to 'ditta'
The toast 'Regole salvate (modifica registrata)' appears even when nothing changed and no log entry is written

action_items: Validate the calcolo override (numeric whitelist) and return 400 instead of 500
Include stores that only have compensazioni in estratti_conto so they show up and can be deleted
Block compensazioni and pagato changes on closed months
Fix the bell/badge overlapping the 'Vai online' button
Make the Gettoni KPI subtitle use cfg.gettone_lordo
Confirm the business rules for residuo when fewer than 3 participants score and for carrying a negative fondo forward
critical_code_review_comments: incentivi.py is 744 lines (>700). Split into config / provvigioni / calcolo / export modules
calcola() is called once per month inside /storico (N full recalculations). It gets slow as months accumulate
_attivita_mese scans all servizi for every calcolo call with no date filter in the query. Add mese filtering at DB level
Storno does not reverse the gettone already paid, and storno of foglio rows is allowed. Check this is intended
